name: Minimized Windows
author: Kunush
description: Minimize windows on any layout and bring them back from a row of floating glass cards with live previews: restore one, several or all, or close an app right from its card. Suggested shortcuts (add them to ~/.config/hypr/bindings.lua, see the README): Super+M minimizes, Super+Ctrl+M shows the minimized windows, Super+Alt+M brings back the last one.
